title: Expedition 70 Axiom Mission 3 International Space Station Hatch Closure - Feb. 7, 2024
description: Axiom Mission-3, the third private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, undocked from the forward port of the International Space Station with its crew of Michael López-Alegría, Walter Villadei, Alper Gezeravcı, and Marcus Wandt on February 7. Prior to undocking, the crew entered their Dragon spacecraft Freedom for the trip back to Earth and a splashdown off the coast of Florida.    Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
